senses.gloss: m. pl. (כסס, adopt. fr. Chald.; cmp. מְלִילָה) nibblings, dessert.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 4:4">Tosef. Ber. IV, 4</cite> <he>כסאנ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>כיסאנ׳</he>, <he>כיסנ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 41b:6">Ber. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>פת הבאה בכ׳</he> bread offered as dessert.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:15">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> top <he>נשים … מיני כ׳</he> women selling all kinds of sweetmeats (<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>בשמים</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:2">Y. Pes. X, beg. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>מיני כִּיסָנִית</he> nibblings.
